title: Rabbi Nezira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bereshit Rabbah 12:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.12.6) has Rabbi Levi speak in Rabbi Nezira’s name. At [11:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.11.2) the name is given as Rabbi Zeira; Hyman calls this an error and proposes Rabbi Nezira.

[Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.8.5.8), [the end of Bereshit Rabbah chapter 82](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.82.15) and Midrash Tehillim 92:4 have Rabbi Levi reporting Rabbi Nezira. Hyman proposes the same reading at [the end of Shekalim chapter 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.2.5.5).[^3]
And we find Rabbi Shimon bar Nezira, [Shabbat 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.33b.4).[^4]

notes.text: The locator ספפ״ב denotes the end of chapter 82, not chapter 2. Hyman’s correction of Zeira to Nezira is retained as his proposal.

The consulted Bereshit Rabbah 12:6 has Levi in Nezira’s name; 11:2 has Levi in Zeira’s name in the parallel light tradition. Hyman’s proposed correction is retained as his proposal, with both consulted forms distinguished.

The parallel in [Midrash Tehillim 92:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tehillim.92.3) has “Rabbi Levi bar Nazra,” while [Yalkut Shimoni 843:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.843.6) twice gives Rabbi Levi speaking in Rabbi Nezira’s name. [Heilprin’s Nezira entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2615&lang=en) records the Yalkut form alongside the difference between the two passages in Bereshit Rabbah. The linked Shekalim passage names Shimon ben Nezira reporting in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name and later has “Bar Nezira.”

The linked Shabbat text gives Shimon ben Nezira as an alternative to Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ze’iri. [Heilprin’s entry on Shimon ben Nezira](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3475&lang=en) also records the Shekalim transmission.
